title: Battery failure mid-route
description: Two delivery drones get battery faults mid-route. @cargo1 loses a cell at 70 s: the cell imbalance takes the BMS to CRITICAL, the DTC gives it right of way and reserves its landing pad, and it diverts. @cargo2 (26 % charge) loses 30 % of its capacity at 80 s and diverts on low reserve. At 85 s the operator grounds every drone still at BMS CRITICAL.
timeline: @cargo1 Sampoorna → SNCC (2.3 km, 80 % SoC); @cargo2 Main Gate → New Hostels (26 % SoC)
@cargo1 cell failure → BMS CRITICAL, right of way, pad reserved, diverts
